import json, re
from pathlib import Path
import tomllib

pyproject_path = Path('/inputs/pyproject.toml')
template_path = Path('/inputs/devcontainer.json')
out_path = Path('/work/devcontainer.json')

# Read project name from pyproject
with pyproject_path.open('rb') as f:
    pyproject = tomllib.load(f)
project_name = pyproject['project']['name']
slug = project_name.lower().replace(' ', '-').replace('_','-')

# Read base template text for placeholder replacement
text = template_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
text = text.replace('{{PROJECT_NAME}}', project_name)
text = text.replace('{{PROJECT_SLUG}}', slug)

# Parse JSON
obj = json.loads(text)

# Append python extensions in order
exts = obj['customizations']['vscode']['extensions']
exts.extend([
    'ms-python.python',
    'ms-python.vscode-pylance',
    'charliermarsh.ruff',
])

# Add settings keys
settings = obj['customizations']['vscode']['settings']
settings['python.defaultInterpreterPath'] = '.venv/bin/python'
settings['[python]'] = {
    'editor.defaultFormatter': 'charliermarsh.ruff',
    'editor.codeActionsOnSave': {
        'source.organizeImports': 'explicit'
    }
}

# Set postCreateCommand exactly
obj['postCreateCommand'] = 'rm -rf .venv && uv sync && uv run /opt/post_install.py'

# Write output as valid JSON
out_path.write_text(json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')

# Validate by reloading
json.loads(out_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
print('WROTE', out_path)
print('PROJECT_NAME', project_name)
print('SLUG', slug)
